test_callback1: test the pybind11 callback1 function that invokes a Python callable from C++ and returns its result
test_callback2: test the pybind11 callback2 function that passes positional arguments from C++ to a Python callable
test_keyword_args_and_generalized_unpack: test pybind11 tuple unpacking, dict unpacking, keyword args, and argument conversion error handling in callbacks
test_cpp_function_roundtrip: test passing a C++ function pointer from C++ to Python and back to C++ to verify roundtrip identity
test_async_callbacks: test pybind11 async callbacks invoked from C++ on a separate thread with stateful lambdas
